validation_not_run: docker build / docker compose config (worker has no shell or network)
npm run build:all (script not yet present in package.json; owned by server implementation task)
all runtime tests and cloud verification (no cloud account, by design)
assumptions: Server task delivers `npm run build:all` producing dist/ and dist-server/main.js per .agents/architecture.md; package.json is forbidden to this task so the script is referenced but not added.
Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK and compose healthcheck call GET /api/health, which the frozen interface guarantees.
In-container HOST=0.0.0.0 is acceptable because compose publishes no host port for the app; Caddy is the only public entrypoint.
Admin token and entry code are only ever runtime env vars; no secrets appear in any committed file.

acceptance_mapping.persistent_volume_explicit: Dockerfile VOLUME /data + ENV DATA_PATH=/data/collection.db; compose named volume collect-data:/data; runbook warns against copying live WAL files and against scaling
acceptance_mapping.no_cloud_success_claimed: Runbook states user has no cloud account, nothing deployed or verified; no prices, pricing deferred to vendor sites
acceptance_mapping.secrets_excluded_from_build: .dockerignore excludes .env/.env.*/*.pem/*.key/private/materials/private/data participants/artifacts/logs/db; compose fails fast on missing ENTRY_CODE/ADMIN_TOKEN; admin export curl reads token from env

remaining: Controller to run docker build/compose config and repo tests after the server build script exists.
User must obtain domain and (if desired) cloud account before any real deployment; ethics/protocol must be finalized before any real participant recruitment.
notes: Commit must be created by the controller (worker has no git tool). Diff kept well under budget; no source/package changes.
